name: Exchange Server by Postgate AI
description:
Exchange Server by Postgate AI connects Claude to Microsoft Exchange mailboxes - including Microsoft Exchange Server SE, 2019 and 2016 on-premises and hybrid environments that no other AI connector reaches. 70 tools cover mail (read, search, drafts, send), calendar
(appointments, availability, meeting scheduling, rooms), contacts, tasks, folders, attachments with PDF/DOCX/XLSX extraction, out-of-office, server-side inbox rules, mailbox statistics, and one-call briefing and meeting-preparation compounds.

Built for teams: every user authenticates individually via OAuth 2.0/PKCE and works with their existing Exchange permissions - no service account, no application impersonation. Credentials are stored RSA-4096-encrypted in a per-user vault. Connected via EWS to Exchange Server SE, 2019 and 2016, on-premises and hybrid. Operated in Germany under a GDPR data processing agreement; message content is neither stored nor logged.

Start a 7-day free trial at https://postgate-ai.com/trial - connect your EWS URL, invite your team, and use your mailbox from Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Exchange Server by Postgate AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Exchange Server by Postgate AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.postgate-ai.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Exchange Server by Postgate AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exchange Server by Postgate AI lists 70 MCP tools, including add_attachment, analyze_contacts, attach_email_to_draft, bulk_email_operation, check_availability, complete_task, copy_email, create_appointment, create_calendar, create_contact, create_draft, and create_forward_draft.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Exchange Server by Postgate AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Exchange Server by Postgate AI in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Exchange Server by Postgate AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exchange Server by Postgate AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Exchange Server by Postgate AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exchange Server by Postgate AI is developed by Postgate AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
